name: Onsen Ryokou Kakumei ~Ich Liebe Dich.!~
original_name: 温泉旅行革命～Ich liebe dich.!～
source:
An adventure game based on Het*lia: Axis Powers. 
Young viewers please be warned. 

K*ku H*nda (Japan) has joined Ludw*ng (Germany) and Gilb*rt (Prussia)! 

Play as Gilb*rt!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE065751.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款基于《黑塔利亚：轴心国》的冒险游戏。
低龄玩家请注意内容是否适合自己。

本田菊（日本）加入了路德维希（德国）和基尔伯特（普鲁士）的行列！

你将扮演基尔伯特！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE065751.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
